workarounds.symptom: Running 'wrangler whoami' or 'wrangler d1 execute --remote' without CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN attempts to open a local desktop browser and deadlocks headless agent stdin/stdout indefinitely.
workarounds.workaround: Export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID into process environment before invoking wrangler, or inspect token presence before running remote commands.

workarounds.symptom: Cloudflare Pages Functions greedy catch-all router (functions/[[route]].js) intercepts GET requests for static CDN assets, returning 404 or 405.
workarounds.workaround: In functions router, inspect request.method: if GET/HEAD, delegate immediately to 'env.ASSETS.fetch(request)'.

workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-36p8-mvp6-cv38] Wrangler affected by OS Command Injection in `wrangler pages deploy` (Affects wrangler < 4.59.1)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade wrangler to patched release >= 4.59.1: npm install 'wrangler@>=4.59.1' (Advisory: GHSA-36p8-mvp6-cv38)
